reason: I already find my plans on Instagram and TikTok and just DM the venue or tap the link in bio, so I'm not downloading another app for something I do a few times a month. The R8 doesn't bother me, but the R5 to get my ticket on WhatsApp feels petty when that's where I live anyway.
objection: Why do I need a whole new app when the link in bio already works? It has to earn its space on my phone, and a brand new app with no track record hasn't done that yet.
would_change_my_mind: If a show I already want to see on Instagram linked straight to TROVE and I could book there without installing anything, with the WhatsApp ticket included free.
